title: THE WARM PATH REPRODUCES THE OLD TRACE
semantic_thesis: The important Round-2.2 result is not merely that Q8_0 again scored 20/24. Under the warm-resident execution path, all twenty-four ordered Q8_0 records reproduced the prior negative run's status, output-hash, and grader-detail trace exactly. In the same runner and Ollama process, forcing an unload/reload before each Q8_0 trial changed the observed path to a stable 24/24 trace, and forcing FP16-to-Q8 switching produced that same stable trace. The evidence therefore narrows the divergence to the warm-resident execution path under the tested configuration, while deliberately stopping short of claiming that model residency itself is the proven causal mechanism.

ru: Мы воспроизвели не только старый счёт — мы воспроизвели старый двадцатичетырёхшаговый trace.
Когда Q8_0 оставался прогретым, старый отрицательный путь вернулся побитно по хэшам ответов; когда модель принудительно перегружалась перед каждым запросом, этот путь исчез в данном запуске.
Это локализация, а не ещё доказанная причина.
Новый диагностический 24/24 не отменяет старые отрицательные receipts и не даёт права на promotion.
Следующий вопрос теперь не 'достаточно ли Q8 точен?', а 'какое именно состояние тёплого пути выбирает один из двух воспроизводимых ответов?'.
en: We reproduced more than the old score; we reproduced the old twenty-four-step trace.
When Q8_0 remained warm, the prior negative path returned exactly at the stored output-hash trace level; when the model was forcibly reloaded before each request, that path disappeared in this run.
This is localization, not yet a proven cause.
A new diagnostic 24/24 cannot erase the old negative receipts and does not authorize promotion.
The next question is no longer only whether Q8 is accurate enough, but which warm-path state selects between the two reproducible outputs.
